verdict.description: Review verdict: issues found, no issues, or incomplete

findings.description: Evidence-backed problems, most severe first; leave empty if there are none, without padding

id.description: Finding ID: F1, F2, and so on

location.description: File:line, or a specific position in the material

trigger.description: What input or state makes it go wrong

evidence.description: Evidence that can be located and checked

checked.description: Material and cases that were checked

not_checked.description: What was not covered or could not be checked without missing material

unverified.description: What remains uncertain or could not be verified
